document.title: KH Checker – API-Aufrufe, Header, Konfiguration, User Needs und UX-Regeln
document.definitionOfAlwaysWorks: Jede Nutzeraktion endet in einem typisierten und verständlichen Zustand. Externe APIs dürfen ausfallen; die App darf dabei weder abstürzen noch einen lokalen Cooldown installieren oder den sofortigen manuellen Retry sperren.

provenance.contractPrecedenceNote: Der v2-Vertrag ersetzt widersprechende v1-Regeln. Insbesondere darf KI keine fehlenden Stückgewichte schätzen; unbekannte zählbare Einheiten müssen in eine deterministische Kalibrierung führen.

userDataBoundary.reason: The APIs remain the source for global product data; local state exists only to improve reliability, preserve user choices and support offline reuse.

nutrition.preparedFoodRule: Use prepared/cooked values when preparation is explicit or implied and the evidence supports that state.

functional.requirement: The user can search branded products and generic foods by text.
Voice input and fully manual entry remain available alternatives.
A user action must resolve to a typed outcome rather than an unhandled UI exception.
The actual carbohydrate total for the requested amount/unit is calculated deterministically.
When available, the smallest reliably proven edible single unit is selected first by default.
When a countable unit lacks a proven weight, the user can determine it by weighing one unit or a user-editable group of units.
Confirmed unit weights persist and are reused for future matching searches, while carbohydrates are recalculated from the current per-100g value.
History and favorites are available and remain device-local.
API and clinic/hospital-list sources use one canonical semantic data model and can later be switched in the UI.

searchReliability.requirement: Fresh canonical cache is checked before every network request.
Kinder Bueno, Kinderbueno and equivalent typography share the same canonical cache key.
Identical in-flight GET requests are deduplicated.
A normal direct-browser search performs at most Search-a-licious plus one OFF legacy fallback.
A valid zero-result response from the primary backend triggers the single fallback.
Stale cache is only accepted after network failure or when the device is known offline, and its age/source are visible.
No local cooldown, countdown gate or request counter may disable immediate manual retry.
The app never issues product searches while the user is merely typing.
Product detail hydration runs only for the selected or uniquely resolved candidate.

ux.requirement: The search action remains actionable during an existing request; another click starts or subscribes to a new attempt instead of waiting for an artificial cooldown.
The actual technical error is visible in an expandable diagnostic area, together with backend, URL, duration, status, response preview and Retry-After.
Diagnostics can be copied for debugging.
Human-readable error copy is shown without replacing or hiding the original technical evidence.
The result view focuses on product image, requested quantity/unit, carbohydrate result and the evidence/provenance used.
The first unit selector option is the recommended smallest edible unit; unresolved units are labelled 'Einzelgewicht ermitteln'; alternatives remain available.
Group weighing shows live unit weight, carbohydrates per unit and requested total before confirmation.
All screens and controls remain usable on small mobile displays, respect safe-area insets and allow reduced-motion preferences.
Controls have explicit labels/ARIA where needed; errors use alert semantics and status notices use status semantics.
Product-category-specific units such as slice, bar, scoop, child portion and adult portion should be semantically selectable, user-editable and persistable where a deterministic contract exists.

deploymentAndPackaging.requirement: The production artifact is a browser PWA, not a JAR or AAR runtime dependency.
The release ZIP contains only the deployable web app artifacts and no bundled global product dataset.
The ZIP is deployable by the existing GitHub Pages workflow, with index.html at ZIP root or under exactly one top-level directory.
All asset, manifest, start and scope paths are repository-subpath-safe and relative.
Normal operation does not depend on an always-running custom backend.
The app remains installable and usable across iOS/iPadOS, Android and desktop operating systems.

privacyAndSecurity.requirement: Browser API GETs omit credentials and referrer information.
OpenAI API keys exist only on the optional server.
No large global OFF database is persisted locally; local storage is limited to cache and user-specific data.
Users can clear API cache, history and saved unit weights independently.

knownGapsAndDecisions.decision: The API/clinic source switch and canonical clinic database semantics are required by contracts/user needs but are not part of the current v__KH_APP_VERSION__ runtime.
Child/adult/custom portion profiles and broader category-specific unit semantics are a requested extension. They require a dedicated deterministic contract before becoming authoritative.

Current product code may continue from a configured gateway to direct v3/v2 sources. Search treats the gateway as authoritative. A future contract should explicitly decide whether product details must also be gateway-only for strict transport isolation.
The legacy v1 permission to estimate piece weights is invalid. v2 requires calibration instead of guessing.
